Trope System

BOLO 89 · the trope register as a browsable system. Built by _tools/tropes/build_glass.py (or command tropes), zero tokens, from _tools/tropes/data/domains/register.json and _tools/tropes/data/trope_graph.json. The doc: ShroomsQ/_CANON/_SSOT/01_NARRATIVE_FRAMEWORKS/ssot_01_trope_register.md.

Layer names and one-line meanings come from each system's SSOT doc (character ssot_02 · setting ssot_03 · genre and texture ssot_01 · theme ssot_06 · tracking ssot_08 · style ssot_07.1 and 07.3). Sexuality keys onto the character layers.

Counts are live from register.json (rebuilt 10/05). The SSOT doc's count table (v0.5.0, 10/03) predates the re-key and reads older numbers.

Links to pages outside the register are dropped at build. Dotted words open a tip: click pins it (links open), Space locks the open tips, Esc clears. Press / to search.
